name: Sunhallow
subtitle: The Night of the Bonfire
author: Luminati
description: Chapter three of Vanquish the Evil Dragon: Sunhallow at night, the fires out, the houses hung with bunting and lanterns, the great bonfire in the square. Generated by tools/make-vanquish-the-evil-dragon.mjs.

objects.name: The Granary
text: The granary door is split down the middle. Sacks of grain spill into the street.

objects.name: The Smithy
text: The forge is lit again. Tobin swears it burns brighter than before.

objects.name: Temple of the Dawn
text: Candles burn on every step of the temple tonight.

objects.name: Merchant Hall
text: The merchant hall is locked. Through a crack: bolts of cloth, untouched.

objects.name: The Sun & Sickle
text: The Sun & Sickle: the roof leaks, the cellar is full. Drinks are free tonight.

objects.name: Elder Hesk's House
text: The elder's door stands open. Nobody is home: everyone is at the bonfire.
Someone has hung a lantern down the well. For luck, they say.

objects.name: Tobin
dialogue: Dance with us! The dragon is dead and the night is young!
talk: Tobin: I'll forge you a blade from one of its teeth. Two blades. A whole rack of them! #line:09DF00D6AD11BBEC015DA801DA2CF8BA

dialogue: 9721492AE26456CADF8C95C8F49CDEF4

objects.name: Old Marta
dialogue: Dance with us! The dragon is dead and the night is young!
talk: Old Marta: Seventy years I've danced at this bonfire, and never once for a dragon-slayer. Go on, pick up your feet! #line:3B53EA30DB69AD6728EC87D289BC4378

dialogue: E99EF14524CFDF345BF0A386EC065E3C

objects.name: Pell
dialogue: Dance with us! The dragon is dead and the night is young!
talk: Pell: When I grow up I'm going to slay a dragon too. A small one, to start. #line:022C1D631753A65308E562012288BA6A

objects.name: Sefa
dialogue: Dance with us! The dragon is dead and the night is young!
talk: Sefa: Saved you a honey cake. Well — I saved you half a honey cake. #line:46D46DBB33A04934CF49356C4F9C88C1

dialogue: D54EBE6FC6B2918D544F9A947D2261CD

objects.name: Old Joss
dialogue: Dance with us! The dragon is dead and the night is young!
talk: Old Joss: Tonight the granary is open to all. Eat, eat! You've earned it ten times over. #line:6CA6E3FFE2EB3F4FA6C5DC2D2AEECF6B

objects.name: Rina
dialogue: Dance with us! The dragon is dead and the night is young!
talk: Rina: They rang the temple bell for you. Did you hear it? The whole valley heard it. #line:5FDF7171655B85CA3FD7B2563395C421

dialogue: 7A04916B36C9CDE5EBF63D71AA84E061

objects.name: Corwin
dialogue: Dance with us! The dragon is dead and the night is young!
talk: Corwin: I watched it fall from the upper town. A star coming down backwards, it was. #line:0CA100FE15A0B934D02987F365B93A0C
